title: a1.* instances are not supported from v1.55

detection.reason: a node's instance type is a label, which the rule vocabulary cannot scan by value

quote: **`v1.55.0` and later of the EBS CSI Driver does not support `a1.*` instances.**
remediation: Move workloads off a1.* (first-generation Graviton) nodes before upgrading — the driver from v1.55 does not support them and the -a1compat image is no longer published, so the node plugin on those nodes cannot run. Replace them with a current Graviton family (m7g, c7g, r7g, …) and drop -a1compat image overrides; Helm installs must also remove a1CompatibilityDaemonSet from their values (chart v2.55 drops the ebs-csi-node-a1compat DaemonSet, and values schema validation may reject the key).
verifyCommand: kubectl get nodes -o json | jq -r '.items[] | select(.metadata.labels["node.kubernetes.io/instance-type"] // "" | startswith("a1.")) | .metadata.name'  # each printed node is an a1.* instance the driver no longer supports
